title: American Missionary Kidnapped in Niger Is Said to Be Released From Captivity
description: The release of Kevin Rideout, an American missionary pilot who was seized in Niger’s capital last fall, has been a priority for the White House.

title: Brazil begins exploring retaliatory options to new US tariffs
description: Brazil has not yet decided whether it will proceed with retaliatory measures, but commits to defending its position.

title: Trump slaps 100% tariff on certain drones over national security concerns
description: The proclamation imposes a 100% ​tariff on drones “of a certain size or with certain capabilities that are particularly sensitive for national security purposes,” according to the White House, including those with a maximum takeoff weight of more than 55 pounds and with thermal imaging capabilities.

title: Colts coach gets knocked down by own player in painful sideline moment
description: There’s always a risk of injury during the preseason, but usually that is for the players and not the coaches.

title: Rich La Jolla punk faces justice after kicking helpless sea lion in viral attack
description: He even called himself “Max Holloway,” referring to the Ultimate Fighting Championship fighter.

title: Bird strike may have caused disastrous Ryanair flight where passenger was nearly sucked out of window: NTSB
description: Malta Air Flight 1879 — a Boeing 737-8AS — was climbing past 16,000 feet after departing Greece for Germany, on July 10 when a fan blade in the right engine fractured, according to the US National Transportation Safety Board.

title: Max Muncy becomes all-time Dodger Stadium home run king
description: Max Muncy picked a good time to make history on Thursday night. Summoned from the bench for a pinch-hit at-bat in the bottom of the sixth inning against the Milwaukee Brewers, the Dodgers’ veteran third baseman flipped the score with a towering three-run, go-ahead homer off right-handed reliever Antonio Senzatela.
